nar_bh.label: Northern Alberta Railways

trips.note: Carbondale to Barrhead by Busby, connecting out of No. 7 from Edmonton. Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.
Barrhead to Carbondale by Busby, connecting into No. 8 for Edmonton. Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.

nar_bh.src: Northern Alberta Railways, table of April 25, 1948 (Official Guide, May 1948, Table 179b)

nar_ww.label: Northern Alberta Railways
dirLabels: to Lac La Biche and Waterways

trips.note: Edmonton to Lac La Biche. No. 25 for Barrhead connects at Carbondale; No. 23 goes on to Waterways next morning. Days worked out, not confirmed. First-class coaches and sleepers (the Guide's equipment note). Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.

Lac La Biche to Waterways, the morning after No. 7 arrives from Edmonton. Days worked out, not confirmed. First-class coaches and sleepers (the Guide's equipment note). Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.

Waterways to Lac La Biche; No. 8 goes on to Edmonton next morning. Days worked out, not confirmed. First-class coaches and sleepers (the Guide's equipment note). Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.

Lac La Biche to Edmonton, the morning after No. 24 arrives from Waterways. No. 26 from Barrhead connects at Carbondale. Days worked out, not confirmed. First-class coaches and sleepers (the Guide's equipment note). Shown in Pacific time, an hour earlier than the Mountain time printed.
